prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity Birdcar marketing WEBSITE homepage screenshot for a direction decision, 1536x1024 landscape. Render the designed website edge to edge, no browser chrome, no device, no mockup frame, no poster.
Input image 1 is TYPOGRAPHY-ONLY reference: it shows the actual bundled Alkaline font. Match its heavy connected signpainting script letter shapes, weight, forward motion, broad rounded strokes and chunky terminals for the Birdcar logo and main display text. Do not copy the reference image's layout, white specimen background, scale relationships, or phrase "More room to grow."
Surface structure: a compact navigation bar integrated into a very large evergreen opening section, followed by a quiet cool-white/mint process section, then an unobtrusive narrow selected-work strip visible at the bottom. Show all these regions in the screenshot so the direction is a usable homepage, not just a hero. The opening section occupies about the top 68% of the viewport. Main focal move: monumental painted script lettering over evergreen, left aligned and generously spaced. Supporting regions remain restrained.
Visual direction: contemporary independent service-shop signpainting translated into a premium modern website for operational problem-solving and custom software. Confident, human, local and capable. Serve established client-facing service businesses including agencies and professional services as well as local businesses; do not make it trades-only. Crisp flat screen rendering, deliberate typographic composition, precise alignment, plenty of breathing room. No aged texture.
Palette: dominant evergreen #075445 covers MORE THAN HALF of the overall image, sharp lime #E1F86D for one right-hand assessment panel, mint #D0E8DA, and cool white #F7F9F2. Primary text on green is cool white; restrained mint supporting text. Dark green text on lime and white. Avoid beige or cream. Typography: accurately match the reference Alkaline for logo and generous main display. Use Barlow, a readable contemporary slightly narrow sans serif, for body and navigation.
Header within evergreen: "Birdcar" logo in Alkaline at upper left, small clean navigation at upper right reading "How it works", "Selected work", "Get in touch". Simple spacing and a subtle fine divider under header; no pill navigation.
Opening left region, broad and dominant: exact headline "Good work. Less running around." in three huge Alkaline lines: "Good work." / "Less running" / "around." Make this expansive, extraordinarily legible, graceful heavy painted lettering, not thin calligraphy. Under it put body copy in Barlow: "Custom systems for established service businesses. We help the work move without all the chasing." The body is clearly subordinate and comfortably readable.
Opening right region: one sharp rectangular lime assessment panel, visually secondary to the huge headline. Heading "Start with what’s painful." in bold Barlow. Supporting copy "A free conversation about where the work gets stuck. A written report with practical next steps. Yours to keep." Prominent dark-green rectangular button with cool-white label "Book a free assessment" and a small right arrow. Quiet line "About an hour. No implementation commitment." No rounded SaaS card, no shadows, no badges.
Lower process section: cool-white surface with a small mint accent. Three clearly ordered stages across the width, using bold Barlow stage titles: "Talk it through", "Keep the plan", "Build what helps". Short supporting copy under each: "We listen to the people doing the work."; "A written report you can use with or without us."; "Scoped implementation, tested with your team." Make the report tangible in the middle stage with a restrained white document preview on a mint rectangle. It is a sample assessment report, not a dashboard. Readable report headings only: "Your assessment", "Where work gets stuck", "Recommended next steps". Simple ruled lines below, no charts, fake metrics, or client data. Supporting regions must remain quiet, not compete with the monumental opening.
At bottom a narrow evergreen or mint strip with small clean text: "Selected work" then "DataDash / Craft & Communicate" and "Workshops / GHX". No invented outcomes.
Constraints: no illustrative bird or car; no photographs needed; no vintage diner aesthetic; no badge collection; no cream editorial treatment; no generic SaaS card grid; no fake testimonials, client dashboards, statistics, outcome claims or invented numbers. Exact main copy and spelling. Functional website hierarchy, clear CTA, consistent spacing, polished high-fidelity screenshot. This is a direction-decision comp, with no approval marker or build-phase label.
reference_role: typography-only; Alkaline letter shapes, not layout or copy
